title: Preferences
description: Configuration consumed by orchestrated agent skills. Resolved from .agents/preferences.yaml at the project level, with ~/.agents/preferences.yaml as a global fallback.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URI for editor tooling.

artifacts.description: Artifact storage configuration: where generated artifacts live and how they are categorized.

base_dir.description: Root directory for all generated artifacts. Supports `~` expansion. Default: `~/ai-artifacts`.

paths.description: Maps artifact category names (e.g., `chats`, `devlogs`, `plans`) to subdirectory names relative to the project artifact directory. Any category key is permitted; values must be strings.

commit.description: Commit-title rendering configuration consumed by the `describe-change.sh` script.

title_format.description: Template string used to render commit titles. Supports tokens such as `{scope}`, `{type}`, `{title}`, `{ticket_ref}` and optional `[...]` groups that drop when their tokens are empty.

editors.description: Optional list of editor configurations mapping file extensions to an editor command.

command.description: Shell command to open files. The file path is appended as an argument.

extensions.description: Glob pattern for file types this editor handles (e.g., `*.md`).

integrations.description: Per-integration configuration. Keys are integration names (e.g., `jira`, `github`, `linear`); each integration object must declare an `enabled` boolean.

merge.description: Squash-merge title rendering configuration for the `merge-pr` skill family.

title_format.description: Template string used to render the squash-merge commit title. Supports the same token vocabulary as `commit.title_format`, plus `{pr_number}`.

strategy.description: Reserved key. Not yet honored by the `merge-pr` skill family — the skill currently performs squash merges unconditionally. Recorded here so the schema does not flag the key as unknown when projects opt to set it in anticipation of future support.

delete_branch.description: Reserved key. Not yet honored by the `merge-pr` skill family — branch deletion is currently controlled by command-line flags and platform defaults. Recorded here so the schema does not flag the key as unknown when projects opt to set it in anticipation of future support.

orchestration.description: Configuration for the multi-phase orchestration pipeline (review rounds, severity thresholds, MCP policy, model overrides).

max_review_rounds.description: Maximum iterative review rounds before marking the run `needs_manual_review`. Overridden by `--max-review-rounds`.

approval_threshold.description: Minimum finding severity required for code approval. Overridden by `--approval-threshold`.

budget_threshold.description: Minimum finding severity for spending remaining review-round budget. Overridden by `--budget-threshold`.

models.description: Per-role model overrides (e.g., `coder`, `architect`, `holistic_reviewer`). Any role key is permitted; values must be strings naming a model.

mcp_policy.description: How to handle MCP unavailability: `required` aborts, `optional` continues with a warning, `prompt` asks the developer.

platform.description: Development platform. Initial supported values are `github` and `bitbucket`; new platforms can be added additively.

title_format.description: Template string used to render pull-request titles. Supports the same token vocabulary as `commit.title_format`.

slug.description: Project identifier used for namespacing artifacts under `{base_dir}/projects/{slug}/`.

ticket_ref_prefix.description: Prefix that appears at the start of `ticket_ref`. Use `#` for GitHub issues (added at render time, omitted from file paths) or a Jira project key like `MAC-` (part of the canonical ticket ID).

repository.description: Repository configuration: default remote and (deprecated) project slug fallback.

default_remote.description: Default git remote used when constructing remote refs such as `origin/main`.

name.description: Name of the default git remote (e.g., `origin`).

slug.description: Deprecated. Use `project.slug` instead. Kept as a fallback.

title_format.description: Template string used to render ticket (issue) titles. Supports the same token vocabulary as `commit.title_format`.
